newsitem.title: USA: Fierce storm approaches western Fiji - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Fierce storm approaches western Fiji - WSC.

text.p: Tropical cyclone Gavin, with top winds of 125 mph, will move over the westernmost part of Fiji in the next few hours before continuing south and starting to weaken, private forecaster Weather Services Corporation (WSC) said on Friday.
Gavin is about 80 miles north-northeast of Nandi, Fiji, and is tracking to the south-southwest at 13 mph.
The northern coastline can expect a damaging storm surge along with strong and damaging winds.
Most of the region can expect heavy rains leading to flooding and winds strong enough to cause serious damage to property and most other structures.
In addition, the system will make for dangerous seas which will affect shipping in the area.
